title: Top-Account "Beta Lane" Commitment Framework & OKR Triage Matrix
creator: Aisha Chen
description:
Background:
Many enterprise customers request roadmap commitments or accelerated delivery windows for features that are not on the public roadmap. Historically, ad-hoc promises have created scope creep, missed SLAs, and misaligned expectations between Sales/Customer Success and Product/Engineering.

Proposal summary:
Create a structured 'Beta Lane' intake and commitment framework for top accounts: a time-boxed, contractual pilot lane that lets us offer early access and limited commitments while preserving roadmap integrity. Pair the lane with an OKR-aligned triage matrix that maps account signals to commitment tiers (No-commit / Beta Access / Scoped Commitment / Contracted Delivery).

Goals:
- Reduce one-off roadmap promises and clarify what counts as a formal commitment.
- Enable prioritized, observable pilots that feed product validation and OKRs.
- Improve GTM alignment so Sales/CS have a fast, consistent decision path for top-account asks.
- Measure renewal/up-sell attribution to Beta Lane participation.

Scope (in-scope):
- Intake form and SLA table for Beta Lane requests (CS template).
- Triage matrix that scores requests on signal dimensions (revenue at risk, feature delta, implementation effort, security/regulatory needs, strategic fit).
- Commitment tiers and example contract language (pilot vs committed deliverable).
- Operational runbook for kickoffs, canary releases, and rollback policies.
- OKR mapping templates to track impact (adoption, latency/cost delta, NPS, renewal signal).

Out of scope (for this ticket):
- Enterprise legal contract templates (Legal will review after framework finalization).
- Any full-time Dedicated capacity procurement; we will surface capacity requests as dependency to Dedicated team.

Decision guardrails and trade-offs:
- We will only offer 'Scoped Commitment' when request scores above 70 on the triage rubric and engineering estimate <= 8 points (or has a funded resource). This balances scope vs risk.
- Beta Lane pilots are time-boxed to 8-12 weeks by default; longer pilots require executive sign-off.
- We will not promise hard latency SLA improvements as part of Beta Lane unless tied to a funded Dedicated commitment.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Public intake form available to CS/SE with fields required for scoring.
2) Triage rubric documented in Confluence with worked examples.
3) Two pilot accounts onboarded into Beta Lane and dashboard tracking created (adoption, errors, cost delta).
4) Playbook for rollout and rollback published and rehearsed with Observability and SE teams.

Success metrics (tracked to OKRs):
- At least 2 Beta Lane pilots yielding product decisions (ship/kill) by end of Q2.
- Increase top-account renewal rate by 6% attributable to Beta Lane interventions (measured via CRM tagging).
- Decrease untracked roadmap commitments reported by Sales by 80% in CS intake audits.

Delivery artifacts (links to be added in comments):
- Intake form (Google Form / CS template)
- Confluence: Beta Lane rubric and runbook
- Dashboard: Beta Lane metrics (Looker/Grafana)
